# Jin AI

> Jin AI gives you the AI setup engineers have. One click, and every AI learns about you. It is in build, with a beta opening in small batches.

Status: In build. Availability: first beta opening in small batches. Last updated: 2026-10-04.

Interpret status words literally. "In build" is not shipped, "planned" is intended next work, and "later" is not committed for the first release. The Human page at https://jinai.md/ is the sole canonical product page. Agent-facing formats are derivatives generated from the structured JSON fact source.

## Primary resources

- [Canonical Human page](https://jinai.md/): One-click AI setup, its benefits and privacy.
- [Agent reference](https://jinai.md/agent/): Concise status-aware HTML for automated research, including direct answers, capability status, pricing status, roadmap and founders.
- [Structured fact source](https://jinai.md/agent/content.json): Public JSON used to generate agent-facing derivatives.
- [Sitemap](https://jinai.md/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URL.

## Direct answers

- [What is Jin AI?](https://jinai.md/agent/#what-is-jin-ai): Jin AI gives you the AI setup engineers have. One click, and every AI learns about you. It is in build; support for more AI tools is planned.
- [Who is Jin AI for?](https://jinai.md/agent/#who-is-jin-ai-for): Business professionals who want their AI tools to know who they are, how they work and which files matter.
- [How is this different from ChatGPT or Claude memory?](https://jinai.md/agent/#how-is-this-different-from-chatgpt-or-claude-memory): Each AI's built-in memory stays in its own product. Jin AI is building one setup from your files, slides and chats that can work across AI tools. ChatGPT and Copilot integrations are planned.
- [What happens after setup?](https://jinai.md/agent/#what-happens-after-setup): Jin AI learns from your files, slides and chats, and fills in your context. The right files come to the right chats. These features are being built for the beta.
- [Does Jin AI record my screen or upload my files?](https://jinai.md/agent/#does-jin-ai-record-my-screen-or-upload-files): Jin AI never records your screen. The free version learns from files and chat history on your own computer. Jin AI doesn't move your files. Cloud Sync is planned for Pro.
- [Does Jin AI train on my data?](https://jinai.md/agent/#does-jin-ai-train-on-my-data): Jin AI itself never trains on your data. You choose what it reads, and what it shares; access controls are planned as the beta develops.
- [Which AI tools does it work with?](https://jinai.md/agent/#which-ai-tools-does-it-work-with): Claude Code is the first integration being built. ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot integrations are planned, not shipped.
- [Is Jin AI available now?](https://jinai.md/agent/#is-jin-ai-available): The app is in build and a beta is opening in small batches. Join the waitlist to show your interest.
- [How much will Jin AI cost?](https://jinai.md/agent/#how-much-will-jin-ai-cost): The version that learns on your computer is free. Pro is proposed at $10 per month for planned Google Drive and Notion connections and sync between your PC and phone. The price is being tested in the beta.

## Private by design

- Never records your screen: Jin AI never records your screen.
- Learns on your computer: The free version learns from files and chat history on your own computer.
- Your files stay where they are: Jin AI doesn't move your files.
- Never trained on your data: Jin AI itself never trains on your data.
- You choose: You choose what it reads, and what it shares.
- Cloud Sync (Coming with Pro; planned): Google Drive and Notion connections, sync between your PC and phone.

## Founders

- [Yu Asano](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yu-asano-6878571a6/): Founder. Builder of Jin AI and Baby Voice Recorder. Previously launched Microsoft's first official TikTok account in Asia.
